box.annotation: Edit step values by mouse click. You can click and drag to edit multiple steps at once. Right click sets the length of sequence to a specific step.

box.text:
knobcolor: 
- ColorSliderInactive when not in length
- ColorSliderInactiveHighlight when full beat
- ColorSliderActive when in length
- ColorSliderActiveHighlight when full beat
- ColorTrigg for a bit when triggered

elementcolor:
- ColorSliderBgInactive when not in length
- ColorSliderBgInactiveHighlight when not in length and full beat
- ColorSliderBgActive when in length
- ColorSliderBgActiveHighlight when full beat
- ColorSliderBgPlaying when currently playing
- ColorSliderBgTrigg for a bit when triggered
